baselineDescription: Working tree after the initial spatial index and socket lookup investigation; exact baseline sources are embedded below.

method.server: 3 alternating sequential pairs per population/route; production bundles; 1800 measured ticks after a complete warm cycle and 300 warm-up ticks; 16 MiB semi-space
method.client: 3 alternating sequential process pairs; prime all five conditions with ten 16-player replays each; then 5 per-case warm replays and 5 samples of 10 replays per process; 30 seconds per replay at 60 render frames/second; 16 MiB semi-space
method.gate: Every population/scenario median CPU increase <=10%; exact server packet/state equality; client steady/slow/outage equality and jitter/burst quality improvement
method.limits: Socket stubs; client production code runs in Node without browser rendering, transport, audio or decoding. CPU excludes compilation and warm-up.
